purpose: Exploratory date-disjoint effective-scale calibration of a class-end model against total bus segment load sums
prior_inspection: 20261026 used for API/schema/route matching; 19,20,26 daily totals and three example cells inspected for non-duplicate responses. No fitted model or accuracy metric inspected before this plan.
evaluation_label: exploratory date-disjoint evaluation, not a preregistered blinded trial
primary_hour_reason: Only complete hourly intervals inside the user-selected 11:20-23:10 collection window
primary_spatial_rule: current from-stop inside the existing provisional campus bounding box; all matched route directions retained
secondary_spatial_rule: all 259 target route links, reported separately
missing_observations: null excluded, never replaced by zero
model_absence: absent conditional model contribution is zero; this does not impute observed nulls
primary_operator: segment-entry hour, an unconfirmed provider-semantics assumption
sensitivity_operator: boarding hour, separately reported without selecting a winner
scale_fit_objective: sum squared residuals on non-null training campus cells; no intercept; analytical nonnegative least squares
coefficient_interpretation: effective scale against all bus passengers, not observed homebound probability, destination share, residence share, or crowding percentage
background: unmodeled in class predictions; independent all-passenger historical mean benchmark reported
limitations: No attendance, exam, cancellation, holiday or weather controls
2026-11 course export used as same-term historical timetable proxy
Only one training and one evaluation week
Provider hourly attribution and exact aggregation formula remain unconfirmed
No observed shuttle queue or per-bus capacity denominator
